note: Provisional v0 taxonomy for Phase 0 validation: latitude band × land/ocean, plus special statuses. Will grow toward ~30 archetypes in Phase 1 (adding e.g. shallow shelf vs open ocean, coastal vs continental interior, mountain-building zones, desert belts). Keep ALL taxonomy changes in this file only.

archetypes.label: Tropical sea
archetypes.description: Warm ocean within the tropics. v0 cannot yet distinguish shallow shelf sea from open ocean — treat as 'tropical shallow-marine' provisionally when near a continent.

archetypes.label: Polar sea
archetypes.description: High-latitude, cold ocean; sea ice plausible depending on epoch climate.

archetypes.label: Tropical land
archetypes.description: Land within the tropics. v0 cannot distinguish rainforest, desert belt, or coastal plain.

archetypes.label: Temperate continental
archetypes.description: Mid-latitude land ('temperate continental interior' provisionally when far from coast).

archetypes.label: Not yet formed
archetypes.description: The crust under this spot did not exist at this time (young oceanic/volcanic crust, e.g. Iceland before ~20 Ma). Product moment: 'the ground under your feet had not been born yet.'
